title: Operations 1.0 schema library
description: Reference a named definition. These schemas define structure for specification release 1.0; the owning documents define semantics. A schema alone activates no payment rail, schedule or deployment.

NameRecord.description: Optional display names profile. Structural check only: NFC, general-category, White_Space, UTF-8 byte-length, name_id, signature and clock rules require semantic validation.

display_name.description: Null withdraws the name. Otherwise 1 to 64 Unicode scalar values, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, already NFC, one line, no Cc, Cf, Cn, Co, Cs, Zl or Zp character, no leading or trailing White_Space and no two consecutive spaces.

NamesPage.description: Optional display names profile. Advisory lookup candidates from one holder; never a claim of uniqueness.

names.description: Current, non-withdrawn records ordered by author_id ascending by ASCII, one per author; enforce semantically.

FeePreflightRequest.description: The intent is cross-validated against the launch schema's AdmissionRequest intent; the authorization covers the computed message ID, provider, author and schedule.

DepositProof.description: An untrusted chain lookup hint, not proof of ownership, finality, payment or authorization.

BalanceStatus.description: Provider assertion of a private liability; not proof of custody, ownership, finality, completeness or solvency.

QualityReport.description: Signed monitor assertions; count and timing relations, sample verification and source trust require semantic validation.

release_signatures.description: Sorted by release_key_id, each key once; at least the release threshold of the set in force at the signed time MUST verify.

SettlementClaim.description: previous_claim_id is null exactly when sequence is 1; the period is at most 7 days; enforce semantically.
